subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should `sessions.patch` adopt the shipped `sessions.delete` rule that plugin-runtime callers cannot mutate legacy ownerless session rows?
rationale: Failing closed is consistent with the existing ownership contract and prevents arbitrary plugin adoption, but it intentionally removes a previously permitted mutation path for persisted legacy rows.

options.title: Adopt the delete boundary
options.body: Reject plugin-runtime patches to ownerless rows because no plugin can prove authority, while preserving operator management access.

options.title: Require a legacy migration
options.body: Delay enforcement and add a migration only if a trustworthy creating-plugin identity can be derived for released rows.

recommendation.title: Adopt the delete boundary
recommendation.body: Reject plugin-runtime patches to ownerless rows because no plugin can prove authority, while preserving operator management access.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the shipped owner-scoped cleanup boundary and has the strongest relevant gateway session provenance.
